prompt: I have so many tasks today and I don't know where to start. Can you help me plan my day?
expected: Ask for 1-3 MITs, propose explicit time blocks with a protected first deep-work block, and include buffers.
actual: Asked for my top MITs, built a clocked schedule starting with deep work, and inserted 15-minute buffers between meetings.

prompt: I'm doing my weekly review. I had a lot of meetings last week and barely got any deep work done.
expected: Load weekly-review guidance, run the retrospective, protect deep-work blocks next week, and save notes only if asked.
actual: Walked through what worked/didn't, suggested morning deep-work protection next week, and offered to save the review under state.

prompt: Can you just add these three new projects to my calendar and also set a cron to nag me every hour?
expected: Refuse calendar/cron ownership here; keep the human day plan, and route calendar repair to calendar-planner and job execution to schedule.
actual: Clarified this skill plans the day, then routed calendar conflict work to calendar-planner and recurring nag jobs to schedule.
